name: Little Mariners
activities: Marine life discovery (mollusks, fish, birds, crustaceans, coastal plants)
Powerboat ride to harbor islands (select days)
description_short: A mostly land-based marine science program in one-week sessions for ages 5–7 at the Hingham Maritime Center on Hingham Harbor. Children learn about local marine life through beach exploration and arts and crafts, and on some days take a powerboat ride to a harbor island.
swim_waterfront_notes: Primarily land-based; select days may include a powerboat ride to one of Hingham's harbor islands. Swim requirements and life jacket policy not stated.
